The implementation is complete. Here's a summary of the changes:

## Changes Made

### 1. `index.tsx` - Hybrid Collision Detection & Drop Animation
- Added custom `collisionDetection` function that uses `pointerWithin` for palette drops and `closestCenter` for canvas reordering
- Added `dropAnimation` configuration with smooth fade-out (opacity + scale down to 0.9)
- Enhanced `DragOverlay` styling with `border-violet-300`, `shadow-xl`, and `backdrop-blur-sm`
- Passed `activeDragItem` to `BuilderCanvas` for drop indicator support

### 2. `builder-canvas.tsx` - Drop Indicator & Enhanced Animations
- Added `activeDragItem` prop to interface
- Added visual drop indicator ("Drop to add question here") that animates in when dragging from palette over populated canvas
- Enhanced question appearance animations with spring physics (`stiffness: 300`, `damping: 25`, `mass: 0.8`)

### 3. `question-card.tsx` - Smoother Sorting
- Changed from `CSS.Transform` to `CSS.Translate` for smoother sortable animations
- Wrapped in `motion.div` with `zIndex: 50` when dragging

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] Drag "Short Text" from palette → canvas shows drop indicator
- [ ] Drop on canvas → DragOverlay fades out smoothly, new question animates in
- [ ] Drag to reorder questions → smooth sorting animation, no jitter
- [ ] Drop outside canvas → DragOverlay returns to origin smoothly
- [ ] Both empty canvas and populated canvas work correctly
- [ ] Mobile/tablet (with Sheet) still works
